name: utility_post_thumbnail
title: Utility Post Thumbnail
description: Thumbnails of a post from data.media.thumbnail = { "default", "web", "media" } (paths relative to src/content/img/projects/). get() falls back to "default"; reference() resolves "@thumbnail.<key>" values. Old forms still work as "default": a plain string in data.media.thumbnail, or data.media.thumbnail_img.
